title: Marketing
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by Kotler & Armstrong (2010) as a social and managerial process through which individuals and organisations get what they need and want by creating and exchanging value with others."

Marketing is defined by Kotler & Armstrong (2010) as a social and managerial process through which individuals and organisations get what they need and want by creating and exchanging value with others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an identifying symbol, mark, logo, name, word or sentence that companies use to distinguish their products from others."
A brand is an identifying symbol, mark, logo, name, word or sentence that companies use to distinguish their products from others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of creating and maintaining a website for your business."
Website development is the process of creating and maintaining a website for your business.
fib: ______ are concerned with the promotion of goods and services to customers to attract their interest.
Marketers are concerned with the promotion of goods and services to customers to attract their interest.
______ is the entire information about characteristics that are common to products which have the same brand name.
Brand positioning is the entire information about characteristics that are common to products which have the same brand name.
______ is the process of examining a specific market or industry to gain insights and make informed decisions.
Market analysis is the process of examining a specific market or industry to gain insights and make informed decisions.
